bug_description: The search-history store persists every keyword as its own preference key and never bounds the number of entries. The history grows without limit, the history component renders an ever-growing ForEach, and preferences storage/flush volume grows with every search.
fix_summary: History is kept as a single ordered JSON list capped at the 20 most recent keywords.

test_oracle.definition: Final absolute app-process PSS after opening the normal history page and a fixed three-second settling period. Kernel smaps_rollup samples bracket the entire page-opening workload. Every trial uses a freshly restored production state derived from the same 2,500 search submissions.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.3 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant
test_oracle.workload_notes: Measure the normal visible history page rather than search results after its history UI is removed. Identical 2,500-submission production states; unchanged business code; threshold raised from 1.2x to 1.3x.
